case_number: 2024 INSC 339; Civil Appeal Nos. …….. - ……... of 2024 (@ Special Leave Petition (C) Nos. 15621-15622 of 2021)
summary: Trust administration succession dispute; Vahiwatdar appointed per 1952 registration application specifying eldest son succession but third son assumed role after elder brother's refusal; delayed filing of Change Report No. 899/2015 (90-day statutory requirement) condoned; co-option of Trustees per Change Report No. 1177/2017 contested; Revision Application No. 61/2017 challenging Deputy Charity Commissioner's acceptance order rejected by Joint Charity Commissioner; statutory provisions examined: Maharashtra Public Trusts Act 1950 Sections 17-22, 41D, 70, 70A; succession rule validity determined against registered object; High Court remand quashed for improper reconsideration of settled facts; final affirmation of Vahiwatdar legitimacy and procedural compliance.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's remand order set aside; Deputy Charity Commissioner's acceptance of Change Reports maintained.
